title: TJC's QOL and performance pack
description: Just a pack that includes the in my opinion most important mods for performance and Quality of life. Also includes mods I just absolutely can't play without.
body: The mods in this pack are the mods I use when I just want to play minecraft _without any big changes_. I made this pack so I could share the mods I use most and recommend. It's focused on _optimizing_ the game and making it _smoother to play_ through some quality of life mods (maybe a bit too many but thats how I prefer it). I hope by sharing this pack you can also have an improved  _vanilla-ish_ experience like me. I hope you have fun with this pack!
